title: What if Earth had two moons?
hook: Imagine looking up one night and seeing two moons.

beats.narration: Imagine looking up one night and seeing not one moon, but two.
In this thought experiment, a smaller second moon circles beside ours.
Pulled from two directions, the oceans could swell into higher, less predictable tides.
Coastlines would reshape, and shore life would adapt to a restless rhythm.
But two moons rarely stay in harmony. Their gravity could slowly unbalance their orbits.
One might collide with the other, or be flung into space.
Only a what if, but it shows how much one Moon shapes our world.
